summary: Marketing Email API v1 sunset on 2025-11-01
details:
HubSpot sunset the v1 Marketing Email API (/marketing-emails/v1/...) on 2025-11-01 in favour of the Marketing Email v3 API; requests to v1 after that date return an error. Other legacy email APIs, including email analytics, are not affected. HubSpot's changelog post is now a 404, so the source is its Wayback Machine copy.

Move email calls from /marketing-emails/v1/emails to the Marketing Email v3 API (POST /marketing/v3/emails to create, GET /marketing/v3/emails to list, GET /marketing/v3/emails/{emailId} to read one) and read folders from folderIdV2: folderId was removed from v3 on 2026-01-28. Other legacy email APIs, such as email analytics, are not part of this sunset.
